desc: 软糯Q弹咬开有夹心，一口一个的即食小点心
leaf: 开袋即食软糯夹心麻薯
name: 软糯Q弹咬开夹心麻薯款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼给出软糯即食小点心的干净形象，靠成组摆盘拿下点击。
主图一秒法则：把核心软糯利益点压在一块整色玫粉面板上，先给理由再往下滑。
shots.textZone: right 40% column, one rounded headline plus one sub-line

shots.intent: 让买家一秒完成口味二选一，减少选择犹豫带来的跳出。
shots.textZone: top band headline plus two short labels beside the pieces

shots.intent: 把同类点心干、硬、掉渣、粘牙的糟糕口感摆成左右两态，放大换掉旧选择的理由。
shots.textZone: one blank label chip per panel

shots.intent: 用咬开断面的湿润夹心做质地实证，把软糯从形容词变成看得见的东西。
shots.textZone: right edge, one short vertical callout

shots.intent: 承接原料说明位：四个拱窗全部留空，只交结构不交事实，等上游填真实内容。
shots.textZone: four blank label chips under the arch row

shots.intent: 把点心放进真实的下午茶桌角，让买家代入自己随手来一颗的画面。
保留规格问答的信息位骨架，六行点线参数全部留空，消除顾虑但不编任何数值。
shots.textZone: screen title chip only; all six value cells stay empty

shots.intent: 用真实摆盘份量与留白的证明位降风险，只给框不给章，信任靠看得见的内容。
shots.textZone: upper band headline; seal and badge shapes stay uninscribed

shots.intent: 收口给一个明确的空白行动位，把前面建立的口感冲动落到一次点击。
shots.textZone: one empty offer band plus one blank button label

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute ready-to-eat bakery-snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of milk-blush field #FBF3F4, bean-paste rose #F1C9D1, deep cocoa-plum text #4C2B33 and one oat-beige insert #F2E3D5; cool soft daylight-balanced key from the upper left at about 6500K with a white bounce card on the shadow side and soft contact shadows only; surfaces limited to a smooth matte rose-lacquer board #EFCBD1, an oat-beige ceramic tile #F2E3D5 and the milk-blush field #FBF3F4, with no wood grain, no linen, no rice paper and no printed kraft; one rounded chubby display headline outlined in deep cocoa-plum paired with one plain geometric sans body; thin-line rose icons, one scalloped paper edge and one hairline orbit ring as the only graphic devices, four-point sparkles on at most two screens; bite-sized pieces never scaled up and always shown whole or cleanly broken with a soft translucent core; generous rounded negative space reserved for copy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no hue added beyond #FBF3F4 #F1C9D1 #4C2B33 #F2E3D5
no mixed fonts and no calligraphy or brush lettering
no wood grain, linen, gingham, rice paper or printed kraft surfaces
no inconsistent lighting and no warm tungsten or amber cast
no cartoon faces, stickers or printed graphics on the food
no packaging artwork, badges or QR codes
style.presentationRules: bite-sized pieces stay bite-sized and never scale up; the same two dry surface finishes and the same clean break-open core recur on every screen; product sits centred or left-weighted with the copy column held on the right or the top band
style.surfaceSystem: smooth matte rose-lacquer serving board #EFCBD1, oat-beige ceramic tile #F2E3D5, milk-blush field #FBF3F4, no wood grain, no linen, no printed paper
